---
title: Meet the group
pagetitle: People
# One listing block per group. Each is scoped to a "people_group" value (see people/_people-template.qmd)
# via "include", so any member's own index.qmd is picked up automatically as long as its people_group
# matches — no need to list members individually here.
listing:
  - id: pi-listing
    contents: "*/index.qmd"
    include:
      people_group: "pi"
    template: _people-cards.ejs.md
  # - id: research_scientist-listing
  #   contents: "*/index.qmd"
  #   include:
  #     people_group: "research_scientist"
  #   template: _people-cards.ejs.md
  # - id: postdoc-listing
  #   contents: "*/index.qmd"
  #   include:
  #     people_group: "postdoc"
  #   template: _people-cards.ejs.md
  - id: phd-listing
    contents: "*/index.qmd"
    include:
      people_group: "phd"
    template: _people-cards.ejs.md
  # - id: visitor-listing
  #   contents: "*/index.qmd"
  #   include:
  #     people_group: "visitor"
  #   template: _people-cards.ejs.md
  # - id: student-listing
  #   contents: "*/index.qmd"
  #   include:
  #     people_group: "student"
  #   template: _people-cards.ejs.md
  # - id: alumni-listing
  #   contents: "*/index.qmd"
  #   include:
  #     people_group: "alumni"
  #   template: _people-cards.ejs.md
page-layout: article
toc: true
---
